about: Recorded results of OBSERVE's OLD root engine (current main before PR-2b) on the deterministic 600-reading corpus of test_engine_resync_differential.py (seed 20261029). 'as_run' is the old engine exactly as it ran (12 readings raised TypeError). 'junk_previous_o2_stripped' is the old engine with a junk context value previous_o2 in (200, 'x') removed before each reading. The old engine no longer exists in the repository, so these recordings are the reference for the differential test. Risk is rounded to 9 decimals.
